watches.title: Recheck UniFi MongoDB compatibility
watches.action: Check the deployed UniFi version against the documented MongoDB support range. If the pending release is supported, approve its dashboard entry, validate the upgrade and backup path, and retain critical-upgrade approval for a database major.

watches.title: Recheck Windows Coral runtime and NumPy compatibility
watches.action: Check for a Windows Edge TPU runtime that supports a maintained Python version and the NumPy 2 ABI. Test actual delegate loading and inference before changing requirements.in and its generated lock together. Python 3.9 is already end-of-life; review this existing security debt even if upstream is unchanged. A different detector backend remains an alternative.
